test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

Mrs. Batra said, “My son wants to study Architecture.”

options.text: Mrs. Batra said that her son wanted to study Architecture.
Mrs. Batra said that her son want to study Architecture.
Mrs. Batra said that her son wanting to study Architecture.
Mrs. Batra said that her son went to study Architecture.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Mrs. Batra said that her son wanted to study Architecture****."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Simple Present Tense. 
 
• The rules of Direct and Indirect speech for interrogative sentence conversions:
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be used.
 
• The first person in reported speech changes according to the subject of reporting speech.
 
• In Reported Speech, the change of the second person depends on the object of reporting speech.
 
• The pronoun 'my' changes to 'her.'
 
• Structure__: (Subject+ V1 + object) (Direct Speech)

 (Subject+ V2 + object) (Indirect Speech)
 
 
• Example: *Navin said, “He leaves the room.”*
 
 

* Navin said that he left the room. *

 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct sentence: *Mrs. Batra said that her son wanted to study Architecture.*
